messages:
Maya (CS): Quick ask 12 lines per account with top product asks + one-line impact. Consolidating for tomorrow's product ops huddle. Drop as CSV-ish lines if easier.

Diego (CS): Starting NovaClin 1) unclear onboarding step that drops API keys after SSO link, 2) want per-route token spend breakdown, 3) need exportable prompt examples for support. Impact: onboarding conversion down ~7%.

Sam (PM): Can we standardize format: `Account  Ask  Impact` (one line)? Makes it trivial to paste into the scoring sheet.

Maya (CS): Yep. Template below.

Maya (CS): ```Account,Ask,Impact,Flags
NovaClin,retain-api-token-post-SSO,drop in onboarding conversion ~7%,[Renewal]
RiverBank,per-route-token-cost-export,finance needs reconciliation,[]
BeaconRetail,export-prompt-examples-for-support,improves time-to-resolution for tickets,[]
SolsticeHealth,webhook-retry-diagnostics,missed 1 sync causing data gap,[Regulatory]
MeridianPay,pin-model-version-per-route,prevent surprise model changes during pilot,[Renewal]```

Jon (Eng): For long-request perf and webhook retries we have a small change queued (`streaming-fallback-202`) that might reduce retry rate. If CS can attach a 5sample of failing requests we can run a canary.

Diego (CS): I'll pull 5 failing traces for NovaClin and SolsticeHealth and mask PII, send to Eng tomorrow.

Aisha (Product Ops): Plan: collect lines by EOD, run frequency x impact scoring, then produce a top-6 for the 9:30 product ops huddle. I'll add tags for `Regulatory` and `Renewal` which auto-bump priority.

Sam (PM): Reminder: if an account is in active renewal or has an exec escalation, tag `[Renewal:urgent]` so we can fast-pass.

Maya (CS): Noted. Also, small UX ask: support asked for a CSV export from the feedback console to attach to tickets. Adding that to the sheet as `export-feedback-csv`.

cs-bot: Friendly reminder: feedback form sent to pilot accounts (NovaClin, RiverBank, BeaconRetail, SolsticeHealth, MeridianPay). Form: https://redwood.app/feedback-form. Reminder scheduled in 2h. :bell:

Aisha (Product Ops): I'll consolidate into `docs/feedback-intake/compact-week.csv` and drop the scored list before the 9:30 sync. If anything becomes a renewal blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:
